title: vpg craft measurements (vpg-measurements/v1)
description: Written by `vpg measure` (vpg/tools/craft.py:measure). Every record names its metric, version and basis hash (vpg/metrics.py); a value of null carries not_measured with the reason. Evidence holds timecodes (seconds), frames and file paths.

frames.description: Per sampled frame: t (seconds) and its colourfulness, ground_colourfulness, coverage and ground_share.
